name: caelo
description: Edit a self-hosted Caelo CMS site from Claude Code: the Caelo MCP server (Power-MCP) plus skills to connect, edit safely (draft, stage, a person publishes) and hand a prototype over to Caelo.

admin_url.title: Caelo admin URL
admin_url.description: Your Caelo admin's address, e.g. https://admin.example.com (https:// required; http:// only for localhost). Leave empty if you have no Caelo install yet.

mcp_token.title: Caelo MCP token (admin scope)
mcp_token.description: Mint it as Owner at /settings/mcp on your install: New token, scope admin. Shown once; stored in your system keychain.

iap_service_account.title: IAP service account (Google Cloud installs only)
iap_service_account.description: Only for installs on Google Cloud behind IAP: the value /settings/mcp shows for CAELO_IAP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT. Leave empty otherwise.
